verdict.rationale: PayPal ships an official Agent Toolkit SDK in TypeScript and Python. It integrates PayPal APIs into OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, Bedrock and MCP through pre-built functions, and the REST portal also lists Server SDKs. A probe confirms @paypal/agent-toolkit is live on npm (1.11.0), and the official GitHub repo corroborates it. Missing for 10: no hands-on verification of the Python package and no detailed SDK reference or versioning docs beyond the tool list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: PayPal's agent toolkit supports the integration of PayPal APIs into AI agent workflows using Amazon Bedrock, CrewAI, LangChain, Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenAI's Agents SDK, and Vercel's AI SDK.

The PayPal Agent Toolkit enables popular agent frameworks including OpenAI's Agent SDK, LangChain, Vercel's AI SDK, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate with PayPal APIs through function calling.
the PayPal Agent Toolkit resolves on the public npm registry (npm view @paypal/agent-toolkit → 1.11.0, dist-tag latest, last modified 2026-09-01)
Integrate with PayPal APIs to access orders, invoices, subscriptions, shipment tracking, transaction details, and dispute management through pre-built functions.
